stage_note: Stages are 7-day spans from the first recorded visit, Sep 25.
clusters_note: Topics a small-business owner searches for before buying an AI receptionist or automation. A page belongs to a topic when its title or H1 contains one of the words. Three pages is full coverage.

subs.name: Answer-first passages
subs.action: Open each product and industry page with a two-sentence direct answer.

subs.name: Quotable facts with sources and dates
subs.action: Put the source and date next to every figure.

subs.name: Entity clarity
subs.action: State who, where and for whom in the first lines of key pages.

subs.name: AI crawler access
subs.action: Allow AI crawlers in robots.txt.

subs.name: llms.txt and machine-readable summaries
subs.action: Publish llms.txt summarising products, prices and industries.

subs.name: Cited by AI assistants
subs.action: Publish short answers to buyer questions so AI assistants can cite them.

subs.name: Featured-snippet and FAQ-shaped content
subs.action: Answer buyer questions in short question-and-answer blocks.

subs.name: Live demo on product pages
subs.action: Put a live voice or chat demo on every product page.

subs.name: Published pricing
subs.action: Publish a pricing page with plan prices per market.

subs.name: Depth and accuracy
subs.action: Add setup steps, integrations and limits to thin product pages.

subs.name: Comparison and alternatives pages
subs.action: Publish comparison pages against the main AI receptionist alternatives.

subs.name: Calculators and downloads
subs.action: Add a missed-call cost calculator.

subs.name: Unique wording per industry
subs.action: Rewrite the near-copy industry pages around each trade's calls, jobs and objections.

subs.name: Coverage of buyer searches
subs.action: Write pages for target searches that have no matching page yet.

subs.name: Freshness, dated facts
subs.action: Date and refresh figures each quarter.

subs.name: Client stories from outside clients
subs.action: Publish case studies from outside clients with named results.

subs.name: Authors, dates and credentials
subs.action: Name the team and its credentials on the About page and on guides.

subs.name: Client reviews (Google, Clutch, G2)
subs.action: Collect reviews on Google, Clutch or G2 from the first clients.

subs.name: Crawl and robots
subs.action: Take the {noindex_pages} out of the sitemap and recheck robots.txt after each release.

subs.name: Sitemap completeness, lastmod, hreflang
subs.action: List the {missing_pages} missing from sitemap.xml, or noindex them.

subs.name: Status codes, redirects, 404
subs.action: Fix broken internal links and error pages.

subs.name: Canonicals
subs.action: Point every page's canonical to its own address.

subs.name: Indexation (live)
subs.action: Request indexing in Search Console for the {unknown_pages} not in Google yet.

subs.name: Page speed proxy
subs.action: Trim the slowest pages first: {slowest}.

subs.name: Mobile, HTTPS, basics
subs.action: Set a mobile viewport on every page and force HTTPS.

subs.name: Titles
subs.action: Rewrite titles that are missing, duplicated or outside 25 to 65 characters.

subs.name: Meta descriptions
subs.action: Rewrite descriptions outside 70 to 160 characters.

subs.name: H1 and heading structure
subs.action: Use exactly one H1 per page.

subs.name: Query-intent match to target searches
subs.action: Give each target search one page and use its wording in the title and H1.

subs.name: Internal linking and anchors
subs.action: Link to weakly linked pages from related pages.

subs.name: Image alt and share images
subs.action: Add share images to the {noshare_pages} without one.

subs.name: Search presence for target searches
subs.action: Strengthen the pages for target searches closest to showing.

subs.name: Referring domains and backlinks
subs.action: Earn links from small-business and trade publications in the US and UK.

subs.name: Brand mentions
subs.action: Get named in GoHighLevel community posts and partner pages.

subs.name: Brand name consistency
subs.action: Use one brand name on the site, listings and profiles.

subs.name: Address, phone, company number
subs.action: Put the registered address and company number in the footer and structured data.

subs.name: sameAs and social profiles
subs.action: Link LinkedIn, YouTube and X profiles to the site and back.

subs.name: Google Business Profile
subs.action: Create a Google Business Profile for the company.

subs.name: Software and agency directories
subs.action: List on Clutch, G2 and the GoHighLevel partner directory.

subs.name: Coverage
subs.action: Add structured data to pages without it.

subs.name: Validity and match with visible content
subs.action: Check structured data against visible content in Google's Rich Results Test.

subs.name: Entity links (sameAs, @id graph)
subs.action: Add LinkedIn and directory profiles to the Organization sameAs.

subs.name: Landing page per market
subs.action: Publish a landing page for each market without one.

subs.name: Search Console and Bing verification
subs.action: Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools.

subs.name: Analytics and conversion events
subs.action: Mark generate_lead as a key event and send one test request to confirm it.

subs.name: IndexNow and sitemap ping
subs.action: Serve an IndexNow key file at the site root so Bing picks up changes.
